added_lines: also, on gurteen parish facebook & instagram st. patrick's church, gurteen sun. 11.30 margaret maree 24.10.'21, parents john 24.10.'83 & margaret costello. bridie coleman 19.10.'21, pat, sons tommy, 15.8.'23, frank, pat joe & james; & decd. of the coleman & sherlock families. tony casey 14.10.'15 john flannery & decd of the casey & flannery families mon. 11.00 paddy mulligan first anniv. 26 oct. brothers joe 6.10.'13, vinny, & christine mulligan 4.7.'25. mon. 7.00 harvest thanksgiving mass for all volunteers: church, community, sports, tues. 10.00 mass. individuals too, who help. wed. 10.00 bridget mary conroy 29.10.'82, husb. elias, sons kevin, seán 5.11.'95 & brendan, his son david, kevin's wife doreen, thurs.10.00 mass. & decd. of the family. fri. 7.00 no mass. sat. 10.00 no mass. sun. 11.30 the community, living & deceased. adoration of holy eucharist wed. 7 – 8pm the rosary is prayed in the last quarter hour. st. joseph’s church, cloonloo sat. 7.00 maureen lyons née o'gara, husb. paddy, john lavin 3.4.'22 & liam o'gara 7.5.'21. sat. 7.00 john francis mcdermott 4.11.'22, & sister christina 25.12.'24. st. attracta’s church, killaraght sun. 9.30 the community, living & deceased. fri. 10.00 mass. sun. 9.30 tommy o’grady 17.10.'05, wife attracta 19.2.'00, son gerry 29.4.'03. mission sunday collection thank you for your envelopes to support the churches, clergy, sisters, catechists, in poorer countries, showing your solidarity to them. envelopes to come, welcome. gurteen

kay mcgrath née killeen of derryknockeran, & providence, rhode is. 1.11.'23 liam allen, london, father of paul, knocknaskeagh. 1.1 1.'23 james gerard o'hara, doon rock, 1.11.'21 feastdays: week 30 ordinary time cycle tues. 27th st otteran of iona, patron - waterford. wed. 28th ss simon & jude, apostles. thur. 29th st colman, bishop aran/ kilmacduagh sun. 1 nov. feast of all saints. cemetery prayers: on sunday 01 nov. killaraght new cemetery - 10.20, after mass. gurteen - 2.15. mount irwin - 3.00. carrantample - 3.45. on sunday 08 nov. templeronan 3.00. killaraght old cemetery 2.15. remembrance service on sun. 22 nov., at 5pm. november masses for the holy souls: november envelopes are at each church door. you can put as many names as you wish. 12 masses will be offered for your deceased. please put your envelope into offertory basket. or, in gurteen, box at blessed sacrament altar, or, return to fr joe at no. 3 cois na h abhann. a modest offering is sufficient. thanking you. gurteen cemetery annual collection , upkeep, improvements. donations welcome at gate next sun. envelopes may be also returned to centra, to the church or to fr joe. carntample cemetery & mount irwin annual collectionfor upkeep & improvements, next sun. gurteen choir would gladly welcome singers & musicians. just over 8 weeks to christmas, for practices before - nora o'connor
. the irish national synodal assembly took place last sat. 17 oct. in gormanston, bringing together nominated lay, clerical & religious delegates. see report on
grásta pre-marriage courses 13-15 nov. & 26-28 feb. 2027. married couples courses 14-15 nov. & 27-28 feb. 2027. course venue: salle pastoral centre, laois r32 n6d8. for information, contact

. lotto gurteen celtic, sun. 18th, 10, 11, 22, 25. €50 to anthony simpson. j'pot €2600, mon. 26th eastern harps 50/50 €580; + mcdermott bingo each fri. at 8pm, in the parish hall. jackpot €2,900 in 47 calls, & lotto j'pot €500. harvest thanksgiving mass to celebrate all who are involved as volunteers in church, community sports, players on teams, also, home helpers. all involved in the many & various ways, giving of their time & talents for others, thereby creating community. not just for volunteers, all welcome. guest speaker fr. dan o'mahony. bank holiday mon. 26 oct. 7pm, gurteen church one of the few occasions when people from the 3 church areas come together. light refreshments in the hall. parish pastoral council – organising. members of the choirs of the 3 churches will combine on the evening. at start, representatives will present items, symbols, of various activities & groups in the community. thank you to members - gurteen parish pastoral council, who have been meeting many times to organise, make contacts, arrangements, & prepare refreshments: maria duignan, chair, bernie o'hara, sec. liz flanagan, patricia mcdonagh, cathal o'gara, jos cryan, tom mccormack, irene mcdonagh, peter deeley, fr joe. baptism we welcomed in the sacrament this sat. cúan coleman lowry, born 14 aug., to kelly (coleman) & darragh lowry, gurteen view. birth congratulations to deirdre (reilly) & john mcnulty, for baby esme bríd, born 17 oct., sister to edie, their home at cois na h abhainn. atractus adult all-female singing group, being formed by victoria massey

. specialising in liturgical & music with a spiritual theme; 2 & 3 part harmonies. due to storm, the first rehearsal in killaraght church postponed to next sat. 4.30. concert before christmas. carn fundraising for all-weather play area. rafflet took place in school yesterday for center parcs €1500 family voucher. great excitement & delight. winners - joe & josephine mcnulty. carn says a huge'thank you' to the school community, families, wider gurteen community, & the very generous local businesses who have supported this raffle! raffle raised €12,890 & €7,725 through online donations, in total €20,615 see it all on facebook.com carn national school mass offerings - a priest may retain one offering (stipend) per day. when there is a second mass or several mass intentions, as recently, the'extra' stipends go to the retired & sick priest's fund, or to the church fund where mass was celebrated.

coping with grief and loss - a four-week programme on ‘finding hope after a bereavement’ in the newman centre, ballina on the tuesday nights of nov., 4th, 11th, 18th, 25th from 8-10pm. presented by monica morley to book a place tel. the newman on

. adult catechism course mondays 7.30 to 9pm, with fr farrell cawley, in the pastoral centre, ballymote, to explore the catechism of the catholic church. new participants very welcome. anam cara , the organisation that supports bereaved parents, will hold its monthly parent support evening on tues. 27 oct. at 7.30pm in the tf royal hotel, castlebar. this event is free, open to all bereaved parents regardless of the age your child died, the circumstances of their death, or how recent their death was. you do not need to register in advance. also, an online support group meeting. to find out more 01-4045378 or email
